runtimeChanges: src/lib/scene/resources.js: omit undefined optional column metadata

changes: Increase flight loop bound from 6 to 12
Resolve gpu-counters.js import to absolute repository path in private driver

limitations: One five-pair capture per build and measurement mode on one machine; not a production comparison.
CPU excludes idle/program samples and includes GC; samples are CPU work, not GPU timings.
Frame p95 is the mean of per-gesture observed completed-frame interval p95s, including gesture boundaries; not a pooled quantile.
Bounds updates per second are sampled accepted domain changes, not GPU layout duration or precise visual FPS.
Expression diagnostics are cumulative through all 12 flights; baseline compiled subplans do not mean the complete expression compiled.
No operation/GPU-counter capture was made for this decoder follow-up; no readback, shader, submission or retained-memory improvement is claimed.
The earlier native Svelte fixture measured preparation reuse; it did not cover the optional metadata in Python scene columns.
A private compiled-gather timing capture overlapped another diagnostic run and is excluded. No gather or backend patch was retained.
